new_threads.name: The unrecognized treasure map
new_threads.reason: The party is following a treasure map whose marked locations they don't recognize; where the treasure lies is still unknown.

new_threads.name: The Clurichen from the riverbanks
new_threads.reason: Reginald warned of a trickster creature that comes into town every night up to no good, a danger that stands on its own.

new_threads.name: The dragon and the Reeve's bounty
new_threads.reason: Eric the Reeve offers 1000 gold for the black dragon's body, and the party gathered lore and accounts of it. The dragon remains alive and unhunted by the party.

new_threads.name: Lady Hilda's offer to join the dragon hunt
new_threads.reason: Hilda would join a party for money to hunt the dragon, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would come back for her services after talking to the Reeve (beat_10).

new_threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer of hire
new_threads.reason: Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.

new_threads.name: Brandonsford's missing shipments
new_threads.reason: Bentley's restock shipment is a week overdue and nothing has come into town in months, and no one is known to have looked into why.

new_threads.name: Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric the Reeve
new_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi insulted Eric and challenged him to a dawn duel that Eric did not accept, and Bentley sent him to the Golden Egg for the night. The ill will remains unresolved.

new_threads.name: Buying Shamus the mule
new_threads.reason: Farmer Gill offered Shamus for 100 gold or for killing the dragon, and Dunk is sleeping in the barn while he considers it.

new_threads.name: Quinn's vanishing ale and the fake shipment
new_threads.reason: Quinn's stock vanishes nightly and he blames Bentley. Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help stage a fake shipment for 100 gold, which has not yet happened.

standalone_beats.reason: The town has no real law enforcement, only a rotating night watch, which may matter later.
Dunk revealed he was sent out of his village young and doesn't know what he is.
Warwick's unsellable mithril chain shirt was noted, but no one pursued it.
Gossip about Ingrid's interest in Warwick, with no pursuit.

shared_subjects.subject: Killing the dragon as work to pay for Shamus
shared_subjects.reason: It is a term of Gill's offer for the mule, so it lives on that bargain.

shared_subjects.subject: Lady Hilda's willingness to hunt the dragon for pay
shared_subjects.reason: The offer is the very thing the Hilda thread is about.

shared_subjects.subject: Eric the Reeve's offense at Sir Phidipaldi
shared_subjects.reason: The ill will belongs to the quarrel, though it could affect dealings over the bounty.
